cases.name: path positional arguments
cases.source: import { basename, join } from 'node:path'; function main(): void { console.log(join('a', 'b'), basename('/tmp/file.txt')); }

cases.name: filesystem sync round trip
cases.source: import { readFileSync, unlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; function main(): void { const path: string = '/tmp/thaw-node-compat.txt'; writeFileSync(path, 'hello'); console.log(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')); unlinkSync(path); }

cases.name: event emitter
cases.source: import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events'; function main(): void { const events = new EventEmitter(); events.on('value', (value: number): void => console.log(value)); events.emit('value', 42); }

cases.name: buffer byte length
cases.source: import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer'; function main(): void { console.log(Buffer.byteLength('雪')); }

cases.name: URL file conversion
cases.source: import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'; function main(): void { console.log(fileURLToPath(pathToFileURL('/tmp/a b'))); }

cases.name: path helpers
cases.source: import { dirname, extname, isAbsolute, relative } from 'node:path'; function main(): void { console.log(dirname('/a/b.txt'), extname('/a/b.txt'), isAbsolute('/a'), relative('/a/b', '/a/c')); }

cases.name: URL string conversion
cases.source: import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; function main(): void { console.log(fileURLToPath('file:///tmp/a%20b')); }

cases.name: event emitter multiple arguments
cases.source: import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events'; function main(): void { const events = new EventEmitter(); events.once('value', (left: number, right: string): void => console.log(left, right)); events.emit('value', 42, 'ok'); }

cases.name: buffer hex round trip
cases.source: import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer'; function main(): void { console.log(Buffer.from('雪').toString('hex'), Buffer.from('e99baa', 'hex').toString()); }

cases.name: process and os metadata
cases.source: import { cwd } from 'node:process'; import { platform } from 'node:os'; function main(): void { console.log(cwd().length > 0, platform()); }
